summary: Verified mobile compact aside fix for /candidato. On iPhone13 (390x844) and Pixel5 (393x851), the dark aside height is ~122.4px (well below 220px target, down from ~600px). p.mt-4 and .mt-10 are display:none, h1 font-size is 22px. Login form section top at ~217-220px is well above the fold and fields are accessible. No horizontal scroll (scrollWidth == innerWidth). Desktop layout unchanged (aside 620px, p/foot visible, h1 30px).
